ayahs.arabic: حمٓ
ayahs.translit: Hameem

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Ha, Meem

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلۡكِتَٰبِ ٱلۡمُبِينِ
ayahs.translit: Waalkitabi almubeeni

t.eng-ummmuhammad: By the clear Book

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ فِي لَيۡلَةࣲ مُّبَٰرَكَةٍۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ
ayahs.translit: Inna anzalnahu fee laylatin mubarakatin inna kunna munthireena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, We sent it down during a blessed night. Indeed, We were to warn [mankind]

ayahs.arabic: فِيهَا يُفۡرَقُ كُلُّ أَمۡرٍ حَكِيمٍ
ayahs.translit: Feeha yufraqu kullu amrin hakeemin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: On that night is made distinct every precise matter

ayahs.arabic: أَمۡرࣰ ا مِّنۡ عِندِنَآۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرۡسِلِينَ
ayahs.translit: Amran min AAindina inna kunna mursileena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Every] matter [proceeding] from Us. Indeed, We were to send [a messenger]

ayahs.arabic: رَحۡمَةࣰ مِّن رَّبِّكَۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
ayahs.translit: Rahmatan min rabbika innahu huwa alssameeAAu alAAaleemu

t.eng-ummmuhammad: As mercy from your Lord. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing

ayahs.arabic: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
ayahs.translit: Rabbi alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma in kuntum mooqineena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them, if you would be certain

ayahs.arabic: لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحۡيِۦ وَيُمِيتُۖ رَبُّكُمۡ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.translit: La ilaha illa huwa yuhyee wayumeetu rabbukum warabbu abaikumu alawwaleena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: There is no deity except Him; He gives life and causes death. [He is] your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers

ayahs.arabic: بَلۡ هُمۡ فِي شَكࣲّ يَلۡعَبُونَ
ayahs.translit: Bal hum fee shakkin yalAAaboona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: But they are in doubt, amusing themselves

ayahs.arabic: فَٱرۡتَقِبۡ يَوۡمَ تَأۡتِي ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانࣲ مُّبِينࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Fairtaqib yawma tatee alssamao bidukhanin mubeenin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then watch for the Day when the sky will bring a visible smoke

ayahs.arabic: يَغۡشَى ٱلنَّاسَۖ هَٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Yaghsha alnnasa hatha AAathabun aleemun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Covering the people; this is a painful torment

ayahs.arabic: رَّبَّنَا ٱكۡشِفۡ عَنَّا ٱلۡعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤۡمِنُونَ
ayahs.translit: Rabbana ikshif AAanna alAAathaba inna muminoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [They will say], "Our Lord, remove from us the torment; indeed, we are believers

ayahs.arabic: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ وَقَدۡ جَآءَهُمۡ رَسُولࣱ مُّبِينࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Anna lahumu alththikra waqad jaahum rasoolun mubeenun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: How will there be for them a reminder [at that time]? And there had come to them a clear Messenger

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوۡاْ عَنۡهُ وَقَالُواْ مُعَلَّمࣱ مَّجۡنُونٌ
ayahs.translit: Thumma tawallaw AAanhu waqaloo muAAallamun majnoonun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then they turned away from him and said, "[He was] taught [and is] a madman

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا كَاشِفُواْ ٱلۡعَذَابِ قَلِيلًاۚ إِنَّكُمۡ عَآئِدُونَ
ayahs.translit: Inna kashifoo alAAathabi qaleelan innakum AAaidoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, We will remove the torment for a little. Indeed, you [disbelievers] will return [to disbelief]

ayahs.arabic: يَوۡمَ نَبۡطِشُ ٱلۡبَطۡشَةَ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ
ayahs.translit: Yawma nabtishu albatshata alkubra inna muntaqimoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: The Day We will strike with the greatest assault, indeed, We will take retribution

ayahs.arabic: ۞وَلَقَدۡ فَتَنَّا قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَجَآءَهُمۡ رَسُولࣱ كَرِيمٌ
ayahs.translit: Walaqad fatanna qablahum qawma firAAawna wajaahum rasoolun kareemun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We had already tried before them the people of Pharaoh, and there came to them a noble messenger

ayahs.arabic: أَنۡ أَدُّوٓاْ إِلَيَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِۖ إِنِّي لَكُمۡ رَسُولٌ أَمِينࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: An addoo ilayya AAibada Allahi innee lakum rasoolun ameenun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Saying], "Render to me the servants of Allah. Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger

ayahs.arabic: وَأَن لَّا تَعۡلُواْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِۖ إِنِّيٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلۡطَٰنࣲ مُّبِينࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Waan la taAAloo AAala Allahi innee ateekum bisultanin mubeenin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And [saying], "Be not haughty with Allah. Indeed, I have come to you with clear authority

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنِّي عُذۡتُ بِرَبِّي وَرَبِّكُمۡ أَن تَرۡجُمُونِ
ayahs.translit: Wainnee AAuthtu birabbee warabbikum an tarjumooni

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me

ayahs.arabic: وَإِن لَّمۡ تُؤۡمِنُواْ لِي فَٱعۡتَزِلُونِ
ayahs.translit: Wain lam tuminoo lee faiAAtazilooni

t.eng-ummmuhammad: But if you do not believe me, then leave me alone

ayahs.arabic: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوۡمࣱ مُّجۡرِمُونَ
ayahs.translit: FadaAAa rabbahu anna haolai qawmun mujrimoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And [finally] he called to his Lord that these were a criminal people

ayahs.arabic: فَأَسۡرِ بِعِبَادِي لَيۡلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
ayahs.translit: Faasri biAAibadee laylan innakum muttabaAAoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Allah said], "Then set out with My servants by night. Indeed, you are to be pursued

ayahs.arabic: وَٱتۡرُكِ ٱلۡبَحۡرَ رَهۡوًاۖ إِنَّهُمۡ جُندࣱ مُّغۡرَقُونَ
ayahs.translit: Waotruki albahra rahwan innahum jundun mughraqoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And leave the sea in stillness. Indeed, they are an army to be drowned

ayahs.arabic: كَمۡ تَرَكُواْ مِن جَنَّٰتࣲ وَعُيُونࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Kam tarakoo min jannatin waAAuyoonin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: How much they left behind of gardens and springs

ayahs.arabic: وَزُرُوعࣲ وَمَقَامࣲ كَرِيمࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: WazurooAAin wamaqamin kareemin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And crops and noble sites

ayahs.arabic: وَنَعۡمَةࣲ كَانُواْ فِيهَا فَٰكِهِينَ
ayahs.translit: WanaAAmatin kanoo feeha fakiheena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And comfort wherein they were amused

ayahs.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَۖ وَأَوۡرَثۡنَٰهَا قَوۡمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
ayahs.translit: Kathalika waawrathnaha qawman akhareena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Thus. And We caused to inherit it another people

ayahs.arabic: فَمَا بَكَتۡ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَمَا كَانُواْ مُنظَرِينَ
ayahs.translit: Fama bakat AAalayhimu alssamao waalardu wama kanoo munthareena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And the heaven and earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ نَجَّيۡنَا بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ ٱلۡمُهِينِ
ayahs.translit: Walaqad najjayna banee israeela mina alAAathabi almuheeni

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We certainly saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment

ayahs.arabic: مِن فِرۡعَوۡنَۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ
ayahs.translit: Min firAAawna innahu kana AAaliyan mina almusrifeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: From Pharaoh. Indeed, he was a haughty one among the transgressors

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدِ ٱخۡتَرۡنَٰهُمۡ عَلَىٰ عِلۡمٍ عَلَى ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.translit: Walaqadi ikhtarnahum AAala AAilmin AAala alAAalameena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We certainly chose them by knowledge over [all] the worlds

ayahs.arabic: وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَٰٓؤࣱ اْ مُّبِينٌ
ayahs.translit: Waataynahum mina alayati ma feehi balaon mubeenun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We gave them of signs that in which there was a clear trial

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ
ayahs.translit: Inna haolai layaqooloona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, these [disbelievers] are saying

ayahs.arabic: إِنۡ هِيَ إِلَّا مَوۡتَتُنَا ٱلۡأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ
ayahs.translit: In hiya illa mawtatuna aloola wama nahnu bimunshareena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: There is not but our first death, and we will not be resurrected

ayahs.arabic: فَأۡتُواْ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.translit: Fatoo biabaina in kuntum sadiqeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful

ayahs.arabic: أَهُمۡ خَيۡرٌ أَمۡ قَوۡمُ تُبَّعࣲ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَٰهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ مُجۡرِمِينَ
ayahs.translit: Ahum khayrun am qawmu tubbaAAin waallatheena min qablihim ahlaknahum innahum kanoo mujrimeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Are they better or the people of Tubba' and those before them? We destroyed them, [for] indeed, they were criminals

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا لَٰعِبِينَ
ayahs.translit: Wama khalaqna alssamawati waalarda wama baynahuma laAAibeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We did not create the heavens and earth and that between them in play

ayahs.arabic: مَا خَلَقۡنَٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.translit: Ma khalaqnahuma illa bialhaqqi walakinna aktharahum la yaAAlamoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: We did not create them except in truth, but most of them do not know

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ مِيقَٰتُهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
ayahs.translit: Inna yawma alfasli meeqatuhum ajmaAAeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is the appointed time for them all

ayahs.arabic: يَوۡمَ لَا يُغۡنِي مَوۡلًى عَن مَّوۡلࣰ ى شَيۡـࣰٔ ا وَلَا هُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Yawma la yughnee mawlan AAan mawlan shayan wala hum yunsaroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: The Day when no relation will avail a relation at all, nor will they be helped

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
ayahs.translit: Illa man rahima Allahu innahu huwa alAAazeezu alrraheemu

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Except those [believers] on whom Allah has mercy. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
ayahs.translit: Inna shajarata alzzaqqoomi

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, the tree of zaqqum

ayahs.arabic: طَعَامُ ٱلۡأَثِيمِ
ayahs.translit: TaAAamu alatheemi

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Is food for the sinful

ayahs.arabic: كَٱلۡمُهۡلِ يَغۡلِي فِي ٱلۡبُطُونِ
ayahs.translit: Kaalmuhli yaghlee fee albutooni

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Like murky oil, it boils within bellies

ayahs.arabic: كَغَلۡيِ ٱلۡحَمِيمِ
ayahs.translit: Kaghalyi alhameemi

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Like the boiling of scalding water

ayahs.arabic: خُذُوهُ فَٱعۡتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
ayahs.translit: Khuthoohu faiAAtiloohu ila sawai aljaheemi

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [It will be commanded], "Seize him and drag him into the midst of the Hellfire

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ صُبُّواْ فَوۡقَ رَأۡسِهِۦ مِنۡ عَذَابِ ٱلۡحَمِيمِ
ayahs.translit: Thumma subboo fawqa rasihi min AAathabi alhameemi

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then pour over his head from the torment of scalding water

ayahs.arabic: ذُقۡ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡكَرِيمُ
ayahs.translit: Thuq innaka anta alAAazeezu alkareemu

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [It will be said], "Taste! Indeed, you are the honored, the noble

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمۡتَرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Inna hatha ma kuntum bihi tamtaroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, this is what you used to dispute

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي مَقَامٍ أَمِينࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Inna almuttaqeena fee maqamin ameenin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place

ayahs.arabic: فِي جَنَّٰتࣲ وَعُيُونࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Fee jannatin waAAuyoonin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Within gardens and springs

ayahs.arabic: يَلۡبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسࣲ وَإِسۡتَبۡرَقࣲ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ
ayahs.translit: Yalbasoona min sundusin waistabraqin mutaqabileena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Wearing [garments of] fine silk and brocade, facing each other

ayahs.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجۡنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Kathalika wazawwajnahum bihoorin AAeenin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Thus. And We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes

ayahs.arabic: يَدۡعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ
ayahs.translit: YadAAoona feeha bikulli fakihatin amineena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They will call therein for every [kind of] fruit - safe and secure

ayahs.arabic: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلۡمَوۡتَ إِلَّا ٱلۡمَوۡتَةَ ٱلۡأُولَىٰۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
ayahs.translit: La yathooqoona feeha almawta illa almawtata aloola wawaqahum AAathaba aljaheemi

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They will not taste death therein except the first death, and He will have protected them from the punishment of Hellfire

ayahs.arabic: فَضۡلࣰ ا مِّن رَّبِّكَۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ
ayahs.translit: Fadlan min rabbika thalika huwa alfawzu alAAatheemu

t.eng-ummmuhammad: As bounty from your Lord. That is what is the great attainment

ayahs.arabic: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرۡنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Fainnama yassarnahu bilisanika laAAallahum yatathakkaroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And indeed, We have eased the Qur'an in your tongue that they might be reminded

ayahs.arabic: فَٱرۡتَقِبۡ إِنَّهُم مُّرۡتَقِبُونَ
ayahs.translit: Fairtaqib innahum murtaqiboona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So watch, [O Muhammad]; indeed, they are watching [for your end]
